scan_targets.description: List of IP addresses, CIDR subnets, or hostnames to scan. Supports wildcards (e.g., 192.168.*.*) and ranges (e.g., 10.0.0.1-10.0.0.5). Must be specified using the --desthost flag or as positional arguments.

interface.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., eth0, enp3s0). If empty, uses default route interface. Corresponds to --interface.

timeout_ms.description: Per-packet timeout in milliseconds before retransmitting. Corresponds to --timeout.

retries.description: Number of times to retransmit a packet if no response received. Corresponds to --retries.

transid.description: Transaction ID (8-hex-char string) for IKE Main Mode exchanges. Useful for testing or evading simple stateless filters. Corresponds to --transid.

vendor_fingerprint.description: Enable vendor fingerprinting by extracting and comparing vendor IDs in IKE responses against a local database. Corresponds to --vendor.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output to display detailed IKE proposals, transforms, and payload contents. Corresponds to --verbose.

extra_options.description: Additional ike-scan CLI options as a single space-separated string (e.g., '--quiet --plainpsk --p1unit').
